channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Miles Bridges | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Miles Bridges from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Danny Wolf on Miles Bridges
item.description:
Danny Wolf on his poster dunk over Miles Bridges:

“Before the game I said I was gonna try to catch a body.”

Danny Wolf on Miles Bridges, Dec 2, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Mitch Kupchak on Miles Bridges
item.description:
Mitch Kupchak on Miles Bridges:

“Our intention is to keep Miles long-term, yes. He's a big part of our future.”

Mitch Kupchak on Miles Bridges, May 19, 2022. Source: Twitter @rodboone.

item.title: James Borrego on Miles Bridges
item.description:
Hornets coachJames Borrego on his team, which recently lost Miles Bridges to health and safety protocols playing through adversity:

“Keep playing, keep fighting, keep grinding... Nobody's feeling sorry for us. This is the way it goes. We need our players to be edgy. I'm edgy.”

James Borrego on Miles Bridges, May 7, 2021. Source: Twitter @osroyparry.

item.title: Kyle Kuzma on Miles Bridges
item.description:
Kyle Kuzma on Miles Bridges:

“It's super cool to have Miles here. I've known him since he was in the 6th grade. I'm happy for him to come into the league & have the success he's had right now...”

Kyle Kuzma on Miles Bridges, Feb 15, 2019. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: Jeremy Lamb on Miles Bridges
item.description:
Jeremy Lamb on @Miles Bridges right-handed tomahawk over Dewayne Dedmon Tuesday night:

“That's the best dunk I've ever seen live for sure. I've seen a lot of great dunks, but that one was amazing.”

Jeremy Lamb on Miles Bridges, Nov 8, 2018. Source: Twitter @rodboone.
